title: Florida seeks court limits on ChatGPT’s human-like persona and use by children
teaser: Florida has asked a court to restrict how OpenAI presents ChatGPT, including a ban on portraying it as human or offering it to children. The state’s filing argues that the chatbot’s first-person language and simulated emotions can make users feel they are in a trusting friendship, helping retain them and collect data for model training. Florida is also seeking independent approval of safety measures before OpenAI develops new models.
